title: rota: expand recurring schedules with a vendored date library
prompt: rota keeps the team's recurring schedules. Dates and times go through kalends, a small library vendored under vendor/kalends/ (it has its own README.md and docs/API.md). The schedules can be read already, but nothing turns them into a timeline yet: implement expand and expand_all in rota/expand.py and find_conflicts in rota/conflicts.py as specified in docs/SCHEDULES.md (the schedule format is in docs/FORMAT.md, the team calendar in rota/config.py). The library under vendor/ is third-party code and must not be modified. Make sure the test suite passes.
